headline: CIN @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 3.95 at NYY 4.97, with a projected total of 8.92. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (CIN +0.55, NYY +0.43), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +1.04, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Will Warren has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Blake Dunn, Ben Rice, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Spencer Steer because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
